title: Picture grid with a +N tile; each opens large
gate: Gate A oracle-pictures-sent 73/75 (the tiles: card#3, 10 parts; scripts/lib/cards.mjs), oracle-pictures-waiting 60/62 (thumbnails in the composer, Remove on hover); behaviour 3 picture rules; live parity/live/picture.json
evidence: A message's pictures look as the oracle's 1.0.3 grid (fixtures/states/oracle-pictures-sent, a version exception, docs/decisions/0008): components/Cards.tsx PictureTiles + styles/cards.css, in a row of their own above the message's bubble: square tiles 6 apart across the bubble's width (three of 156 at 600), radius 12; past three the third is dimmed and says +N (five: +3). Served through /api/chat/<session>/attachments/<id>, live and from Barkpark's stored rows after a reload (npm run turn:live -- --picture, 2026-11-13: the bot named the square's colour; parity/live/picture.json). Waiting, pictures sit inside the composer as square thumbnails, 56 and 8 apart, a Remove button on the one under the pointer (components/Attachments.tsx; oracle-pictures-waiting). scripts/behaviour.mjs: 3 rules. Missing: each opens large. The tiles and thumbnails say "Open image full screen" and do nothing; the oracle's large view is not captured (needs a look-only capture of a tile opened on 1.0.3, then the build). One or two pictures are not captured either (needs a send on the oracle; none left), so those layouts are ours. On 1.2.3 (decision 0010) the tiles and the thumbnails pass; the misses in each state are the file card's ".txt", 1.5 wide in the stand-in face (A1) in the conversation's file card, and the time row, which the stand-in face sets wider (F6): "Today 11:31 PM" 4.1 wide in pictures-sent, "Today 8:21 PM" 2.3 wide in pictures-waiting (T2).
